name: flag-dannebrog-lyndanisse
description: A red banner with a white cross was said to drop from heaven during a crusade battle in Estonia, rallying the Danes.

name: flag-first-union-flag
description: England's and Scotland's crosses were merged into one design for ships of both kingdoms under a single king.

name: flag-grand-union-raised
description: Rebel colonists flew a banner of thirteen red and white stripes with the old crosses in the corner aboard a warship.

name: flag-stars-stripes-adopted
description: Congress resolved that the new republic's flag would have thirteen alternating red and white stripes and thirteen stars.

name: flag-french-tricolour-adopted
description: The revolutionary assembly decreed that the national flag would carry three vertical bands of blue, white and red.

name: flag-italian-tricolore-first
description: A green, white and red banner was adopted by a short-lived republic in northern Italy, ancestor of the national flag.

name: flag-union-flag-st-patrick
friendly_name: St Patrick's Cross Joins the Flag
description: With the union of Great Britain and Ireland, a red diagonal cross was added, giving the Union Flag its present design.

name: flag-argentina-belgrano
description: A general on the banks of the Paraná River unfurled a sky-blue and white banner for his troops, to the government's displeasure.

name: flag-greece-adopted
description: The Greek national assembly chose a flag of nine stripes and a white cross, said to echo the syllables of a battle cry.

name: flag-irish-tricolour-presented
description: A nationalist leader returning from France showed a green, white and orange flag meant to join two traditions in peace.

name: flag-japan-hinomaru-decreed
description: A red disc on white was decreed as the design for merchant ships, soon becoming the symbol of the nation.

name: flag-brazil-green-gold
description: Days after the monarchy fell, a new banner with a yellow diamond and blue globe replaced the imperial flag.

name: flag-philippines-unfurled
description: From a window of a family mansion near Manila, a sun-and-stars banner sewn in exile was shown as independence was proclaimed.

name: flag-australia-first-flown
description: After a nationwide design contest, the new federation's flag bearing the Southern Cross flew over Melbourne.

name: flag-thailand-tricolour-adopted
description: A king replaced an elephant flag with horizontal bands of red, white and blue, matching the colours of his wartime allies.

name: flag-germany-black-red-gold
description: The new republic chose a tricolour whose colours traced back to the liberal movements of the previous century.

name: flag-soviet-hammer-sickle
description: The union of socialist republics fixed a red flag bearing a crossed hammer and sickle beneath a gold-bordered star.

name: flag-india-tricolour-adopted
description: The constituent assembly approved a saffron, white and green flag, with a wheel of law at its centre, just before freedom.

name: flag-israel-adopted
friendly_name: Israel Adopts the Star of David
description: A provisional council chose a white flag with blue stripes and a blue hexagram, based on a prayer-shawl design.

name: flag-china-five-star-raised
description: Over a huge crowd in Beijing, a red flag with a large gold star and four smaller ones was hoisted for the first time.

name: flag-ghana-raised
description: A black star on a tricolour flew over the first sub-Saharan colony to win freedom, setting a style many nations copied.

name: flag-nepal-double-pennant
description: A constitution fixed the design of two stacked crimson triangles, making the only national flag that is not a rectangle.

name: flag-canada-maple-leaf
description: A red and white flag with a single maple leaf replaced the Red Ensign on Parliament Hill after a long national debate.

name: flag-uae-raised
description: Six sheikhdoms joined under a flag of pan-Arab red, green, white and black, raised at Union House in Dubai.

name: flag-bangladesh-adopted
description: After a war of separation, the new republic formally fixed a flag with a red circle on a deep green field.

name: flag-zimbabwe-raised
description: A new flag with a white triangle, red star and the Zimbabwe Bird replaced the colonial banner at midnight celebrations.

name: flag-russia-tricolour-returns
description: After a failed hardline coup, the white, blue and red tricolour replaced the hammer and sickle as the Russian republic's banner.

name: flag-south-africa-new
description: A six-colour design with a sideways Y was raised just before the country's first all-race elections.

name: flag-kosovo-unveiled
description: A blue flag with a gold map of the country and six white stars was shown as a new Balkan state declared itself.

name: flag-south-sudan-raised
description: The world's newest country hoisted a black, red and green flag with a blue triangle and gold star at its birth ceremony.
